description:
Property portals often hide the house number but show the home's past sale
prices. HM Land Registry records every sale by exact address, so the sale history
identifies the home: give the area and the sales, get the address or addresses that
match. One match is the answer. Several means add another sale or a tighter area.
None means check the year (portals show the year the sale completed) or widen the
area. The returned `akey` works with every per-address tool.

area.description: Where the listing says the home is: a street with its district ('Merton Road, SW19'), a postcode or its first half ('SW19 1'), or a town.
area.title: Area

match.description: 'any' (default): the home has these sales, possibly among others. 'last': the newest sale given is the home's most recent sale. 'only': the home has exactly these sales and no others.
match.title: Match

sales.description: Past sales shown on the listing, each as 'price:year' in pounds, for example ['450000:2019', '310000:2012']. More sales narrow it faster.
sales.title: Sales

name: find_address_from_sale_history
title: Find the address behind a listing from its sale history
